title: Catalog Artifact Tags
description: Schema for remote artifact tag list with display extensions

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: The tag name: a semver version (e.g. 1.2.0) or an alias (e.g. stable, latest)

version.title: Version
version.description: The resolved semver version for the tag; empty for non-semver alias tags

isSemver.title: Semver
isSemver.description: Whether the tag is a valid semantic version rather than an alias
